priors.name: N0
priors.source: ChatGPT 2.5 B prompts/day (TechCrunch, Jul 2025); Google ~480 T tokens/month (May 2025) at an ASSUMED 1-3 k tokens/request; other providers by judgment

priors.name: M_c
priors.source: Google 0.24 Wh (Elsworth et al. 2025); Altman 0.34 Wh; Oviedo et al. 0.31 Wh

priors.name: sigma_c
priors.source: Oviedo IQR 0.16-0.60 around 0.31 implies sigma ~ 0.98; +/-0.3 by judgment

priors.name: beta
priors.description: Fleet overhead (network x daily load x redundancy)
priors.source: Oviedo beta = 1.31 = 1.10 network x 1.08 daily load x 1.10 redundancy; 1.0 if the median already includes idle capacity

priors.name: r
priors.source: Oviedo: 13x median energy for 15x tokens; AI Energy Score v2: 30x average (GPU-only, non-production)

priors.name: a
priors.source: Bai et al. 2026: ~1000x tokens, input-dominated, so the energy multiple is lower. ASSUMPTION

priors.name: w_RT
priors.description: Reasoning share of requests, delivery year

priors.name: w_AT
priors.description: Agentic share of requests, delivery year

priors.name: lam
priors.source: Two-point fit to Google's token growth: ln(49) -> ln(6.7) gives ~0.7

priors.name: h
priors.source: Oviedo 8-20x line-of-sight; Blackwell 1.5-2.5x per watt; AI Energy Score v2: most newer models not more efficient

priors.name: tau
priors.source: Patterson et al. 2022: about 3/5 of Google's ML energy for inference and 2/5 for training (2019-2021), i.e. tau ~ 0.67 (checked in arXiv 2204.05149)

priors.name: s_US
priors.description: US share of global AI load

priors.name: s_PJM
priors.description: PJM share of US data-centre load
priors.source: PJM Nov 2025: PJM ~40% of US data centres in 2025

priors.name: kappa
priors.source: Oviedo S5: peak/average node power 1/(f + (1-f)/(1+a)) = 1.235; PJM's flat 70% utilization ~ 1.0
